images.filename: The Feast in the House of Levi by Paolo Veronese (edited 2).jpg
images.caption:
Paolo Veronese, Dinner (even banquet or feast) in Casa Levi - Oil on canvas of Venetian Mannerism, at Galleries of the Academy of Fine Arts in Venice: - 1 architecture and sculpture (loggia in serliana, classical Palladian-Sanmichelina Renaissance architecture, Corinthian order, Doric-Tuscan in the right background, female bas-reliefs winged with victories ?, ideal city)
- 2 at night
- 3 table set (food, wine, goblet glasses, jugs, glasses)
- 4 clothes (silk, ermine, turbans, fine fabrics)
- 5 social classes (soldiers, patricians, bourgeois, servants, prelates, saints, jester, children, adults, men, waiters), multi-ethnic (Italians, Africans, Ottoman Turks, Germans)

- 6 animals (dogs and cat in the centre, hawk with falconer on the right)

images.caption:
Cortile del Convento dei Lateranensi della Carità, oggi Gallerie dell'Accademia di Venezia. 
Progettato da Andrea Palladio, il cortile costituisce parte dell'ampliamento del monastero (1560) che, insieme alla Scuola Grande e alla Chiesa di Santa Maria della Carità, ospita le Grandi Gallerie dell'Accademia di Venezia.

images.caption: Courtyard of the Lateran Convent of Charity, today the Gallerie dell'Accademia in Venice. Designed by Andrea Palladio, the courtyard forms part of the extension of the monastery (1560) which, together with the Scuola Grande and the Church of Santa Maria della Carità, houses the Great Galleries of the Academy of Venice.
